info.title: Toilet-bound Hanako-kun
info.synopsis: Un giorno come tanti, Nene Yashiro s'imbatte in Hanako-san, una sorta di spiritello noto come uno dei 7 misteri della scuola, finendo per diventare la sua assistente umana. Le loro avventure si snodano tra le varie leggende metropolitane che popolano la scuola.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Yashiro Nene is looking for ghostly help with her love life, but when "Hanako-san," the wish-granting spirit that haunts a girls’ bathroom stall, turns out to be a boy, she may end up getting more, and less, than she bargained for.

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: Yashiro Nene is looking for ghostly help with her love life, but when "Hanako-san," the wish-granting spirit that haunts a girls’ bathroom stall, turns out to be a boy, she may end up getting more, and less, than she bargained for.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: A rash of mysterious thefts hits the school, and rumor has it that the apparition "Yousei-san" is behind it. When Nene catches sight of the creature, will she end up losing more than just her school supplies?

tmdb.title: Episodio 2
tmdb.synopsis: A rash of mysterious thefts hits the school, and rumor has it that the apparition "Yousei-san" is behind it. When Nene catches sight of the creature, will she end up losing more than just her school supplies?

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Nene’s best friend vanishes without a trace and no one else remembers she ever existed! To get her friend back, Nene is forced to call on Hanako for help and journey into a "Boundary" between the world of the living and the world of the dead.

tmdb.title: Episodio 3
tmdb.synopsis: Nene’s best friend vanishes without a trace and no one else remembers she ever existed! To get her friend back, Nene is forced to call on Hanako for help and journey into a "Boundary" between the world of the living and the world of the dead.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Nene, Hanako, and Kou have reached the top of the Misaki Stairs, where a mysterious and bewitching woman awaits them. Will Nene get her friend back, or will she vanish along with her?

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: Nene, Hanako, and Kou have reached the top of the Misaki Stairs, where a mysterious and bewitching woman awaits them. Will Nene get her friend back, or will she vanish along with her?

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: The school is full on unlikely couples thanks to a tree that rumor has it makes any confession made under it succeed. When Hanako asks Nene to meet him there, Nene starts to suspect that he sees her as more than an assistant.

tmdb.title: Episodio 5
tmdb.synopsis: The school is full on unlikely couples thanks to a tree that rumor has it makes any confession made under it succeed. When Hanako asks Nene to meet him there, Nene starts to suspect that he sees her as more than an assistant.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: In search of Hanako’s secrets, Nene and Kou enter the fifth Wonder, the 4 O’clock Library. Its books contain the past and future of every student their school has ever had, but some knowledge comes at a price.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: In search of Hanako’s secrets, Nene and Kou enter the fifth Wonder, the 4 O’clock Library. Its books contain the past and future of every student their school has ever had, but some knowledge comes at a price.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Nene’s relationship with Hanako becomes strained after she learns about his past. With some baking help from Kou, she tries to talk things out with Hanako over donuts, but their heart-to-heart is interrupted by a shocking intruder!

tmdb.title: Episodio 7
tmdb.synopsis: Nene’s relationship with Hanako becomes strained after she learns about his past. With some baking help from Kou, she tries to talk things out with Hanako over donuts, but their heart-to-heart is interrupted by a shocking intruder!

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Kou gets more than he bargained for when he tries to help a student’s ghost rest in peace. The late Mitsuba may look delicate, but his language is anything but. Can Kou put up with him long enough to help him?

tmdb.title: Episodio 8
tmdb.synopsis: Kou gets more than he bargained for when he tries to help a student’s ghost rest in peace. The late Mitsuba may look delicate, but his language is anything but. Can Kou put up with him long enough to help him?

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: After a surprise invitation, Nene finds herself kidnapped and taken to... a fancy tea party? Nene quickly drops her guard in coversation with the beautiful and mysterious Sakura, but is their meeting as innocent as it seems?

tmdb.title: Episodio 9

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Nene finds disembodied hands appearing in her old club photos! Then, hands start sprouting around her in real life too! They seem harmless, but is there something sinister behind them?

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa rescues Nene and Mitsuba from the Hell of Mirrors, but does the mercurial ghost have something worse in store for them? Meanwhile, Hanako and Kou race to find a way to follow Nene, but will they make it in time?
